scope: Audit the complete prepared train partition, freeze a larger Qwen curriculum, and fit two offline CPU controls. No new Qwen training, reserved outcomes, downloads or trading.

findings.original_twenty_update_trial: Fifteen examples were no-opportunity; LLL, SSN and SSS were absent. This identifies a supervision coverage gap, not a proven causal explanation for the adapter's collapsed predictions.
findings.cpu_controls: The unweighted classifier has slightly better joint probability scores than its fit-only prior but extremely sparse directional predictions. Softened class weighting increases predictions while reducing directional precision and worsening probability scores.
findings.decision: Neither control demonstrates a deployable trading strategy. Keep both CPU models and the original Qwen adapter quarantined; do not choose a trading policy or tune thresholds from this study.

training_data_audit.joint_state_key: N=neither_positive, L=long_positive, S=short_positive; positions are extra 1/2/4 round-trip ticks

session_boundary_split.unit: Whole source_session, chronological 75/25 session-count split within train only
session_boundary_split.exposure: All sessions are previously exposed 2025 development, NOT an independent holdout

qwen_plan.pool: Inner fit sessions only; every inner check session excluded
qwen_plan.selection: Label-stratified training-only undersampling with session-spread even ranks, no duplicate cases, and fixed joint-state round-robin order
qwen_plan.initialization: Fresh pinned Qwen3-4B-Base, NOT the twenty-update adapter

planned_recipe.loss: Completion and EOS only; prompt masked

qwen_plan.warning: Uniform joint-state sampling changes priors. At the lowest cost, the planned sample contains 96 long, 96 short and 32 neither examples, unlike the natural fit distribution. False signals may increase; balancing is not guaranteed improvement.

cpu_study.normalization: Population mean/std from fit-session features only; constant scales set to one
cpu_study.initialization: Zero weights and Laplace-smoothed weighted fit-only log prior

limitations: The complete train partition was audited, but the CPU models fit only its first 84 sessions. This is not analysis or training of reserved 2026 outcomes.

The inner check is already-exposed development. The original Qwen trial fitted five of its cases, so it cannot be reused for an honest inner-check comparison without restarting from the base checkpoint.
The two CPU controls use all 14,670 inner fit examples; the future Qwen trial will use only 224. Their data budgets differ and must be reported, not mistaken for an architecture-only comparison.

Targets are observability-conditioned 6E futures quote-opportunity classes at a 100ms delay and 15s hold. Counts and probabilities do not establish realized PnL, loss magnitudes, CFD basis, broker costs or fills.
Prediction counts at nested cost settings share cases and must not be summed as distinct trades.
The small directional sample and very low recall do not support high-frequency execution or profitability claims. Reweighted probabilities are not calibrated market likelihoods.
No hyperparameters were tuned or models refitted after viewing check scores. The balanced Qwen recipe remains a proposed bounded experiment, not evidence that balancing will solve the task.
next: Implement a separate source-bound native worker for the frozen 224-case curriculum, retaining completion-only loss, immutable base weights, token/gradient/resource guards, durable per-update receipts and exclusive outputs.

Preregister the later-session Qwen diagnostic sample and all comparisons before fitting; enforce the new 30-minute worker budget and zero automatic retries without altering the original twenty-update worker or artifacts.
Start from the pinned base, save a separate quarantined adapter, then compare against frozen CPU controls. Keep reserved 2026 validation, test and lockbox outcomes out of tuning.
Do not connect any candidate to trading unless independent evidence and broker-specific paper execution economics separately justify it.
